You should never ever convert because your in-laws think that’s the right thing to do . Converting is a big deal and it’s not easy , especially if you choose a conversion that’s accepted by the rabbanut . So if it’s not something that you really desire to do , don’t . 
There are many many christians and other religios people living in Israel and your children will be fine . 
Also , they can convert if that’s what they choose to do later on .
